summary: On a solo Hardcore expedition, the protagonist reaches an unvisited ravine containing a burned cabin and an active portal.
goal: Understand the impossible construction before night forces him away.
decision: He inspects the persistent block evidence instead of treating the ruin as scenery.
consequence: The portal becomes an actionable contradiction rather than an unexplained background object.
new_information: The cabin and frame were deliberately built in a region he has not previously visited.
audience_effect: Immediate danger from the cold open is joined by a fair environmental puzzle.
deletion_impact: Without the authored ruin, entering the portal lacks mystery and later construction has nothing precise to fulfil.
production_note: Show map-edge or coordinate context, a burned stone shell and no second avatar or invented evidence.

summary: He chooses to enter the active portal beside the blast cavity.
goal: Test the only object capable of explaining the ruin and temporal contradiction.
decision: He crosses despite having no verified destination or return frame.
consequence: He is ejected into the same ravine before the cabin, stair or portal exists.
new_information: The portal routes through time rather than to an ordinary Nether destination.
audience_effect: The title mystery expands into questions about when the ruin was made and whether it is his future.
deletion_impact: Deleting entry removes the displacement, relationship, fire, builder reveal and closed journey.
production_note: Use one controlled temporal transition and match natural geography exactly.

summary: In the pristine ravine, he chooses to camp near the absent portal site and investigate rather than begin a long blind journey.
goal: Survive the night and preserve access to the only temporal evidence.
decision: He builds a temporary shelter on the west shelf and gathers local resources.
consequence: The practical camp creates the foundation of the later cabin.
new_information: Every player-placed block from the opening lies in this location’s future.
audience_effect: Disorientation gives way to cautious possibility.
deletion_impact: Without settlement, the cabin and relationship never acquire ordinary causes.
production_note: Capture the pristine shelf and bare cave before placing any construction.

summary: He tames Moss and turns the temporary shelter into a shared working home.
goal: Create a safe routine while he studies the portal site and gathers supplies.
decision: He uses bones earned from a skeleton, feeds Moss, builds around the terrain and sits the wolf only before dangerous ravine work.
consequence: The cabin footprint and sit-follow ritual become durable parts of the world.
new_information: The wolf’s obedience and the cabin’s distinctive geometry arise through normal play.
audience_effect: Warmth and rapport make the remembered ruin emotionally threatening.
deletion_impact: Without the bond and routine, Moss’s death is mechanical leverage rather than earned loss.
production_note: Use real taming, feeding, following, building obstruction and return-from-mine actions.

summary: Recognising the opening ruin in his own foundation, he decides to leave with Moss after neutralising the lava and collecting portal material.
goal: Prevent the remembered fire without abandoning the only route he may be able to reconstruct.
decision: He stone-clads the stair, seats Moss away from the lava and begins cooling and mining the shelf.
consequence: A visible firebreak exists, but one continuous stripped-spruce support remains concealed behind it.
state_change: Attachment under threat becomes active prevention.
new_information: The future ruin is his cabin, and its apparent hazard can be investigated through block continuity.
audience_effect: Recognition produces hope because he acts promptly and sensibly.
deletion_impact: Deleting recognition removes his prevention strategy and makes later fulfilment coincidental.
production_note: Match the granite seam, foundation bend, chest recess and stair rib to the opening ruin.

summary: Mining the final accessible obsidian opens a lateral lava flow that reaches the hidden timber support.
goal: Remove the lava hazard and obtain enough obsidian for a controlled return frame.
decision: He keeps water on the visible face and mines the cooled block, accepting the ordinary risk of another source behind it.
consequence: The side flow bypasses the visible stone cladding and ignites the continuous support.
new_information: The fire begins through ordinary material adjacency created by his own build and mining choices.
audience_effect: Hope reverses into causal dread without invoking supernatural correction.
deletion_impact: Without the concealed side flow and support, the fire is arbitrary or requires an invented force.
production_note: The lava path, ignition distance and timing require target-version reproduction.

summary: He abandons every structural objective and attempts to release Moss, but reaches the sitting place too late.
goal: Save Moss regardless of the cabin’s destruction.
decision: He directs his single water source towards the wolf, ignores storage and breaks the shortest route through the wall.
consequence: Moss dies from fire damage before the release interaction completes; the cabin burns to the opening state.
new_information: The sit routine and hidden fire route, not a house-versus-wolf choice, caused the loss.
audience_effect: The cold-open question resolves tragically while preserving the protagonist’s moral priority.
deletion_impact: Deleting the failed rescue removes the emotional cause of portal construction and the story’s tragic centre.
production_note: Rehearse fire stages, water route, interaction distance and wolf damage; do not claim reliability before testing.

summary: After tracing the burn path, he builds the remembered frame to seek another chance before the fire.
goal: Use the only temporal mechanism he has witnessed to return to Moss while it is alive.
decision: He rejects departure and immediately reconstructs the economical frame from locally mined obsidian.
consequence: The cobblestone foot, asymmetry and ignition position reproduce the portal from the opening.
new_information: The unknown builder is the protagonist after Moss’s death.
audience_effect: Mystery satisfaction is inseparable from concern about his haste.
deletion_impact: Without this decision, the title question and closed personal journey remain unanswered.
production_note: Repeat the opening portal composition through actual mining and block placement.

summary: While he attempts an emergency lava-and-spruce ignition, a creeper from the dark branch detonates and kills him.
goal: Activate the frame immediately without the flint, steel and spare iron lost in the fire.
decision: He continues the ignition while damaged and without restoring the branch torch or defensive equipment.
consequence: The close blast is terminal and breaks the cobblestone lip retaining his placed lava.
state_change: Desperate builder becomes absent builder; contained ignition becomes altered fluid geometry.
new_information: The opening blast cavity and lack of a builder are consequences of the final attempt.
audience_effect: The apparent accident becomes the earned lethal reversal.
deletion_impact: Without the creeper event, his absence and the blast geometry beside the opening portal have no cause.
production_note: Confirm spawning or approach logic, blast radius, health state and Hardcore presentation in the target build.

summary: The altered lava reaches the remaining spruce, fire forms inside the valid frame and the portal activates for his earlier personal self.
goal: Create a route back through the ignition arrangement he chose before death.
decision: His prior placement of the lava source, retaining lip and spruce cradle allows the post-blast fire path to complete.
consequence: The active portal survives beside burning drops and later becomes the impossible frame encountered at the beginning.
new_information: The creeper did not directly create fire; it exposed the ordinary lava-and-wood ignition that lit the portal.
audience_effect: The builder, activation, blast cavity and journey close in one visual causal pay-off.
deletion_impact: Deleting activation breaks the opening premise and leaves the frame inert despite every preceding cause.
production_note: Test blast-modified flow, fire spread into the frame, item destruction and portal persistence; use a match cut rather than a duplicate-avatar shot.
